Beast Form Quirk.name: Beast Form Quirk
Beast Form Quirk.description:
🐻 You change into a great beast you choose: a bear, a big cat, a wolf, a boar or a dragon.

🌱 At the start claws come in an instant and the full form in seconds: the size of a large bear, strong enough to push a car aside, with senses far past any person's.
📈 With training: tracking by scent, pinning a villain under your weight, bounding up buildings with people, sheltering people under you, a freezing roar, house size.
⚠️ Pain, fear and anger pull you toward instinct.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, as the beast pushes back under stress.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Ryukyu (Dragon), Jurota Shishida (Beast).

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Intimidation +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Raking Paw, Full Shift
Beast Form Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user changes into one beast form picked at creation (bear, big cat, wolf, boar, dragon) and back. At first: claws at once, full form in seconds, about large-bear size, pushes a car aside, tracks a fresh scent across several blocks, held about ten minutes; wings only glide. More needs learned techniques. Limits: the hide turns fists and knives, not bullets. The form cannot use tools, fit through doors or say more than a few rough words; strong smells and loud noise overwhelm it. Pain, fear and rage pull the user toward instinct; clothes tear. Quirk Strain: light: claws, sharper senses; moderate: full form, tracking, a pounce, a climb; heavy: sheltering people, a roar, a long fight; severe: the rampage, the greater form. Type: Transformation. Law: the full form in public draws police at once; an unlicensed claw or bite wound counts as assault with a weapon. Look: the body swells under fur, scales or hide, face to muzzle; eye and hair colors carry over.
